Shirley is brown-skinned with brown hair and brown eyes. They are also distinguished by having very rosy cheeks.

## History

Following his birth, Shirley's mother [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) became very ill for a long period of time, leading [Susan Baker](../character/susan.md) to mother the baby with passionate tenderness and nearly save his life. During his parents' absence, Shirley spent three months living at the home of [Susan](../character/susan.md) Baker's brother. He later sat sleeping on the [Ingleside](../codex/places.md#ingleside) veranda alongside his mother, [Susan](../character/susan.md), and [Rilla](../character/rilla-blythe.md) as they waited for a visit from [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md).

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER I. HOME AGAIN P1](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0001), [v5 CHAPTER I. HOME AGAIN P2](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0002), [v5 CHAPTER I. HOME AGAIN P4](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0004), [v5 CHAPTER I. HOME AGAIN P7](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0007), [v5 CHAPTER I. HOME AGAIN P8](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0008), [v5 CHAPTER I. HOME AGAIN P16](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0016)_

## Quotes

> "In the years to come thy memory will shine like a star over my lonely life, as that last story we read together says. Diana, wilt thou give me a lock of thy jet-black tresses in parting to treasure forevermore?"
>
> — Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P10](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0010)

> "Fare thee well, my beloved friend. Henceforth we must be as strangers though living side by side. But my heart will ever be faithful to thee."
>
> — Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P12](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0012)

> "That is all there is left in life for me, now that my friend has been ruthlessly torn from me. In school I can look at her and muse over days departed."
>
> — Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P17](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0017)

> “I think he has only been its nominal head for many years,” said Anne. “He is a very old man; his nephews are really at the head of the institution.”
>
> — Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream P35](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0035)

> “If I had been the boy you sent for,” said Anne wistfully, “I’d be able to help you so much now and spare you in a hundred ways. I could find it in my heart to wish I had been, just for that.”
>
> — Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream P40](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0040)

## Relationships

### [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/diana-barry--shirley.md)

[Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) is Anne's intimate bosom friend, though they were temporarily forced apart by Diana's mother. They share a tight bond marked by dramatic farewells, secret note exchanges, and confidences about romance and engagements. Even as they grow older, support each other through major life milestones, and face impending separations, they maintain a deep, enduring closeness.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P0](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P9](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0009), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P16](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0016), +20 more_

A New Interest in Life P9](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0009), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P0](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0000), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P15](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0015), +1 more</sub>

### [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/gilbert-blythe--shirley.md)

[Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) start out as fierce academic rivals in school, competing closely for top honors like scholarships and medals. Over time, their dynamic softens into a deep personal connection, though [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) initially rejects his proposal after viewing him merely as a friend. However, a life-threatening bout of typhoid fever forces [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to realize her true love for [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), ultimately leading toward their marriage.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P0](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P16](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P28](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0028), +21 more_

- Rival of — academic rivals in schoolwork  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036)</sub>

### [Fourth](../character/fourth.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/fourth--shirley.md)

[Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) the [Fourth](../character/fourth.md) are close comrades who live and work alongside one another at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). They spend their time picking strawberries, tidying the house, and keeping company. Together, they work to support Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), helping her prepare for [Stephen](../character/stephen-irving.md) Irving's visit and joyfully watching her reconcile with him.

_Sources: [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P48](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0048), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P57](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0057), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P59](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0059), +2 more_

- Comrade of — chums living and working together at the stone house (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P48](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0048)</sub>

### [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/lavendar-lewis--shirley.md)

Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) are warm friends and frequent visitors who enjoy spending time together at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) steps in to cheer up Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) during her periods of despondency, assists in delivering a message from [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), and helps prepare [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) for Stephen's arrival and their eventual garden wedding. During her visits, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) also confides personal matters to Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), such as her decision to decline Gilbert's proposal.

_Sources: [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P1](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0001), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P22](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0022), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P31](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0031), +23 more_

- Friend of — close friends and visitors (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P32](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0032), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P18](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0018), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P34](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0034)</sub>

### [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/paul-irving--shirley.md)

[Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) is an imaginative pupil under Anne's mentorship at the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school. They form a special bond beyond the classroom, with [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) cheering [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) up with gifts like wild orchids and sharing walks together to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). When [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) resigns her teaching post to attend college, her departure causes [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) deep distress.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P0](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0000), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P13](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0013), +21 more_
